Chapter 380 - 380 Regret; Apologize! (2)

Chapter 380 - 380 Regret; Apologize! (2)

380 Regret; Apologize! (2)

How could someone take a taxi?

Perhaps the driver felt that Lin Fan was not sincere enough.

Therefore, he could not be bothered to chat with him anymore.

A moment later, the driver stepped on the brakes and stopped in front of a gorgeous manor.

This… It was the Zhou family’s residence at Soaring Road No. 1.

After Lin Fan paid the money, he strode forward.

The driver looked at the red light in the distance and could not be bothered to drive forward immediately. He looked at Lin Fan’s figure from afar and sneered, “He’s really going to Soaring Road No. 1. This guy is too good at pretending. If he really has the ability, let me see if he can just walk in.”

As Lin Fan got closer and closer to the entrance of Soaring Road No. 1, the smile on the driver’s face grew wider.

In the next moment…

The driver froze.

That was because the two security guards standing at the door quickly went up to Lin Fan when they saw him.

One of them even led him in very respectfully.

This young man… He was really a guest of the Zhou family!

Heavens!

What kind of big shot was he?

Just as the driver was in a daze, a honk sounded from behind.

It turned out that the taxi had stopped for too long and the red light had turned green.

Only then did the driver put away his thoughts and forcefully suppress the shock in his heart. He suddenly stepped on the accelerator and sped into the distance.

…

Even though Lin Fan had come to the Zhou family a few months ago and had seen the tall rockery, the clear stream, and the colorful flowers…

When he saw them again, he could not help but sigh in admiration.

It was extremely beautiful.

A moment later, he arrived at the main hall of the Zhou family.

“Long time no see, Little Brother Lin!” Zhou Guotao laughed heartily.

Obviously, the Zhou family… was all waiting for Lin Fan… This young man was only in his 20s!

If there were outsiders here, their jaws would definitely drop to the ground in shock.

This was the Zhou family, one of the top families in Hua Nation!

Even if Lin Fan had saved Old Master Zhou’s life, he did not need to be so polite, right?

However, ordinary people did not know that Lin Fan was a member of the Dragon Division.

At the same time, he also saved the lives of Old Master Zhang Jian’s grandson and Old Master Qin Weiming’s grandson.

In addition, Lin Fan invented the earthquake prediction device, super battery, and medicine to treat diabetes. He also solved many math problems.

These… It made Lin Fan befriend the Zhou family, the Zhang family, and the Qin family. Furthermore, he became the pillar of the country!

Zhou Guotao understood that as long as Lin Fan wanted to… In the future, he would definitely not be weaker than the Zhou family. In fact, he would far surpass the Zhou family!

Lin Fan said, “Old Master Zhou, long time no see.”

The two of them talked as they walked inside, laughing from time to time.

Zhou Guotao had already treated Lin Fan as someone of the same generation.

At this moment, a man in a suit walked over and said respectfully, “Old Master, Feng Baohua, the head of the Feng family, brought a few people from the Feng family and said that he’s here to apologize.”

Zhou Guotao did not reply immediately. He looked at Lin Fan and said, “Little Brother Lin, do you want to meet them?”

“Let’s see what they have to say first,” Lin Fan said.

Zhou Guotao nodded at the man in a suit.

After a while, Feng Baohua, who had white hair on his temples, and Feng Jiaqi, who had been beaten up till his face looked like a pig’s head yesterday, walked over.

The Feng family was based in Jingbei… It could even be said that they had a certain reputation in the entire Hua Nation.

In the past, no matter where the Feng family went, they could be arrogant.

However, at this moment, they were all hunched over, extremely nervous.

Feng Baohua said, “Greetings, Old Master Zhou.”

Zhou Guotao only replied with a soft hum, his attitude extremely cold.

Feng Baohua became even more flustered and hurriedly said, “Yesterday’s matter was due to our Feng family’s lack of discipline. Today, we specially came over to apologize…”

“You didn’t offend me; you offended Little Brother Lin!” Zhou Guotao said indifferently.

Feng Baohua followed Zhou Guotao’s finger. Yesterday, he had already found out about Lin Fan from Feng Jiaqi.

He also knew that Lin Fan was very young.

However, after seeing him, he could not help but be shocked.

Such a young man had actually made the old master of the Zhou family personally question him. Moreover, he had even let out a thunderous rage.

From last night to this morning, all of the Feng family’s businesses had suffered a terrible blow.

Many of his business partners had severed all ties with the Feng family.

“Mr. Lin, I’m sorry. Our Feng family isn’t strict with our discipline. This has caused a junior to bully others…” Feng Baohua hurriedly said.

At this point, Feng Baohua turned to Feng Jiaqi and shouted, “Hurry up and apologize to Mr. Lin!”

Feng Jiaqi was so frightened that he trembled and knelt on the ground. He said in a trembling voice, “M-Mr. Lin, I’m sorry. It’s all my fault. I was blinded by greed. I beg you… I beg you, please forgive me…”

As he spoke, snot and tears flowed down his face.

Yesterday, after Feng Jiaqi returned to the Feng family, he was scolded badly.

Some said that they were going to kidnap him and send him to the Zhou family.

Some said that they should break his four limbs to show the Feng family’s sincerity.

Some said that he had to kneel in front of the Zhou family’s door for three days and three nights.

…

Lin Fan looked at Feng Jiaqi’s pitiful face and said, “Feng Jiaqi has learned his lesson. Let’s forget about this matter.”

Feng Jiaqi was so excited that he could not stop kowtowing. “Thank you, Mr. Lin, thank you.”

“Thank you, Mr. Lin…” Feng Guohua also said.

Then, his gaze fell on Zhou Guotao.

“Little Brother Lin is kind-hearted, so he easily forgave you…” Zhou Guotao said. “However, I don’t want something like this to happen again.”

“Yes, yes, yes… I promise that this will never happen again,” Feng Guo Hua replied repeatedly.

“Alright, you can go now,” Zhou Guotao said.

Then, Zhou Guotao, Lin Fan, and the core members of the Zhou family sat in the living room and chatted.

At night, they had a sumptuous dinner together.

Lin Fan was undoubtedly the main character of the banquet.

Originally, the Zhou family wanted Lin Fan to stay.

However, Lin Fan realized that Xu Jingrou might still be waiting for him at home.

Hence, he tactfully declined.

…

When Lin Fan arrived at Unit 2104, Xu Jingrou had just taken a shower. There were still a few drops of water on her snow-white skin.

Under the illumination of the light, her skin was as translucent as jade, and the water droplets were as translucent as gems embedded on the surface.

Coupled with Xu Jingrou’s voluptuous figure and exquisite facial features…

Her entire person was like a perfect piece of art. Lin Fan was stunned for a moment.

Xu Jingrou saw that Lin Fan was staring at her with his naked eyes. She blushed and said, “Why are you standing at the door? Why aren’t you coming in?”

“Ah… Ah… Alright…” Lin Fan replied.

The moonlight was like a blanket, and the ground was like a bed.

….

It was a sleepless night.

….

The next day, the sky was bright.

When Lin Fan opened his eyes, Xu Jingrou had already changed and was about to leave.

When she saw that Lin Fan had woken up, she said, “Breakfast is on the table. I’m leaving.”

After saying that, she hurriedly walked out.

Lin Fan smiled and shook his head. He looked at his phone.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 7,598,000 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Then, Lin Fan turned his attention to the sign-in system.

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained ten units of Ocean Villa Lavie.]

Ocean Villa Lavie. Lin Fan was rather familiar with this name.

This was because he had seen this villa often when he was watching reels a while ago.

According to the reels, this was the most luxurious villa in the capital, and each one cost more than one billion yuan.

In addition, even if one had money, one might not be able to buy it. One had to have an extremely high status.

It was even rumored that when President Ma wanted to buy a villa, he did not succeed.

Now, he had directly obtained ten villas?

They were worth tens of billions?

It seemed… not bad.

Then, Lin Fan slowly got out of bed and leisurely ate the noodles on the table.
